{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the revenue column: check for commas and values
print("Unique revenue values (first 20):")
print(df['revenue'].unique()[:20])

# Check if there are any commas
has_commas = df['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False).any()
print(f"Does revenue contain commas? {has_commas}")

# Convert revenue to float after removing commas
# First, check for any non-numeric or malformed entries
malformed = df['revenue'].str.contains(r'^[0-9,]+\.?[0-9]*$', na=False)
print(f"All revenue entries are numeric format? {malformed.all()}")

# Now convert
df['revenue_float'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Confirm conversion worked
df[['revenue', 'revenue_float']].head()"}
